description: This PHP class defines the EmployeePictureModel, a data model used in the OrangeHRM system's API to represent employee picture metadata, including properties such as employee number, filename, file type, size, width, and height. It implements serialization and normalization functionalities through traits and interfaces, facilitating API responses.

classes.name: EmployeePictureModel
classes.description: A model class for representing employee picture data in the OrangeHRM API, utilizing traits for serialization and normalization, and encapsulating an EmpPicture entity.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with an EmpPicture entity and sets the corresponding filters and attribute names for serialization.
